explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 107-108, a long straddle is constructed by buying a call and a put with the same strike and same expiry. Pages 108-109 confirm that the maximum loss equals the total premium paid and that profits arise from large moves in either direction. The Trap: Buying a call and put at different strikes is a strangle, not a straddle - distinguished on page 111. Note: Per pages 108-109, the break-even points are at strike plus total premium on the upside and strike minus total premium on the downside.
